title: River Development Agent Governed Executor Integration Active Admission Verification Foundation
objective: Verify an exact trusted DEV-302 active-admission authorization result while preserving the separately governed active-admission boundary and creating no admission, dispatch, execution, mutation, network, secret, shell, or external-side-effect authority.
constraints: DEV-302 authorization state must be ACTIVE_ADMISSION_AUTHORIZED.
DEV-302 must remain an active-admission authorization decision only.
DEV-302 authorization result must remain inert data.
DEV-302 must require a future separately governed active-admission boundary.
DEV-302 blocked reasons must be empty.
Required predecessor lineage and evidence must be present.
All inherited and downstream authorities must remain denied.
Verification must not itself admit, activate admission, dispatch, invoke an executor, or execute an operation.
Verification must not modify, delete, stage, commit, push, or deploy repository content.
Verification must not access secrets, expand scope, perform arbitrary shell execution, perform network execution, or perform external side effects.
A future separately governed active-admission boundary remains required.
